metaDescription: {siteName} helps Jewish and Israeli travelers, families and investors find homes in Georgia and contact owners directly — in five languages, with strong scam protection and no booking fees.

hero.title: A home in Georgia, made for our community
hero.lead: {siteName} is a home-listing site for Georgia — the country in the Caucasus. It connects Jewish and Israeli travelers, families and investors with owners of apartments, houses, rooms, hotels and property for sale.

what.title: What {siteName} is
what.p1: Think of a classifieds site you can trust, with the look and feel of a modern travel app. Owners post homes for short stays, monthly rent or sale. Guests search, compare and contact the owner directly, in the app the owner prefers.
what.p2: We add the details that matter to our community: a kosher kitchen, Shabbat-friendly features, the walking time to the nearest synagogue, Shabbat times for every city and Jewish holidays in the calendar.
what.p3: At launch we don't take bookings or payments. You agree everything with the owner yourself — and we work hard to make sure the person on the other side is real.

highlights.title: In short
highlights.a: Homes in Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi and across Georgia
highlights.b: Short stays, monthly rentals and property for sale
highlights.c: Kosher, Shabbat and synagogue details on every listing
highlights.d: Direct contact with owners — no booking fees

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.lead: One site for four kinds of people, each with their own needs.

guests.title: Guests and renters
guests.body: Travelers, families, students and religious families looking for a short stay or a monthly rental — close to a synagogue, with a kitchen they can use.

buyers.title: Buyers and investors
buyers.body: Israelis and Jews buying property abroad — Batumi and Tbilisi are popular — who want clear prices, honest details and an owner they can talk to.

owners.title: Private owners
owners.body: People who own a home, apartment or room in Georgia and want to reach the right guests or buyers — for free, in five languages.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.body: Hotels, guesthouses, property managers and agents. They get a “Business” label, so guests can choose to see private owners only.

story.title: Our story
story.noteTitle: This section is waiting for the founders
story.noteBody: The founders will write our story here: who we are, why we started {siteName} and what home means to us. Until then this note stays visible, so no one mistakes it for finished text.
story.noteHint: Suggested topics: how the idea started, the people behind it, and why Georgia.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Simple for guests, free for owners.

step1.title: Search and filter
step1.body: Filter by city, dates and price, and by Jewish-friendly details such as a kosher kitchen or the walk to a synagogue.

step2.title: Check the listing and the owner
step2.body: Look at the photos, the details and the owner's verification badges.

step3.title: Contact the owner directly
step3.body: Message the owner on WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber or by phone. We charge no booking fees.

how.link: See how it works in detail

values.title: What we stand for
values.lead: The promises behind every page of the site.

trust.title: Trust
trust.body: Every listing is checked, owners earn badges by proving who they are, and everyone sees safety tips at the moment they make contact. Trust is the product.

community.title: Community
community.body: Built for the community, with features that make it easier to keep your traditions while you travel. Everyone is welcome to use the site.

jewishFriendly.title: Jewish-friendly
jewishFriendly.body: Kosher kitchens, Shabbat-friendly homes, synagogue walking times, Shabbat times and holidays — details you would otherwise have to ask about one by one.

direct.title: Direct contact, no booking fees
direct.body: You talk to the owner in the app they prefer and agree everything between you. We don't add a fee to your stay.

languages.title: Five languages
languages.body: Hebrew, English, Russian, Arabic and Georgian. Listings are translated automatically, so owners and guests understand each other.

contact.title: How to reach us
contact.lead: Questions, ideas or a problem with a listing — we're here to help.

help.title: Help center
help.body: Answers to common questions about searching, posting, contacting owners and safety.

form.title: Contact form
form.body: Write to the team, with or without an account. We reply by email.

email.title: Email
email.body: Prefer email? Write to us at <mailto>{email}</mailto>.
